models.name: Qwen3.5 4B
models.description: Qwen3.5-4B (Q4_K_M GGUF, llama.cpp). The local model for document drafts on a graphics card; private, needs review.
models.notes: Measured on an RTX 3060 Laptop (Vulkan, f16 KV): 1,378 prompt / 35 output tokens per second at 4k; 2.6 GB of weights in video memory; 3.4 GB at 8k context, 3.7 GB at 16k. Map recall 1.00 on a 20-minute synthetic meeting.

models.name: Ministral 3 3B
models.description: Ministral-3-3B-Instruct-2512 (Q4_K_M GGUF, llama.cpp). The local model for document drafts on the processor; private, needs review.
models.notes: Measured on a Ryzen 7 5800HS (8 threads): 45-60 prompt / 6-9 output tokens per second at 1-4k context; on Vulkan 2.8 GB of video memory at 4k. Map recall 0.93 on a 20-minute synthetic meeting.
